Treatment summary
Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with complaints of low back pain and stiffness radiating into
the left hip region. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the forces involved in a crash of this type, and the
presenting symptoms align with a lumbar strain. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm soft tissue injury to
the lumbar paraspinal musculature, with documented restricted range of motion and localized tenderness. No prior complaints or
treatment involving this body area are known from the patient history or available records. Over the course of care the patient
completed 18 visits, a somewhat longer course than typically seen for this injury, consisting of manual therapy, supervised
exercise, and home program instruction. Billing records reflect single entries for each service rendered, with no duplicated or
repeated charges. Patient has shown gradual improvement and is expected to reach maximum medical improvement with
continued home exercise and periodic reassessment.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
